text: The 2025 loss area is classified as native forest by Uruguay’s Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National Forest Cartography 2021. MGAP’s dataset maps 13.1 hectares of the 13.5-hectare loss area as native forest, with no planted forest detected. The classification aligns with the JRC 2020 reference, which confirmed 98% of the area was forested in 2020, and Hansen GFC 2025, which identified the tree-cover loss. MGAP’s mapping is the authoritative source for forest type in this case.
